_comment: The issue #137 sweep corpus, pinned. run_sweep.py converts each package with rypip (which resolves the pinned version from PyPI into its cache), builds the generated crate, and records the rustc error histogram. Keep this list small and meaningful: each package adds a full convert+build to every sweep.

packages.name: urllib3
packages.note: The historical #137 corpus. Round 55: the bool-and-boxed-value fold fix and the urllib.parse calls (~1086 rustc errors, measurable; every round's delta is measured against this).

packages.name: certifi
packages.note: Close to a fully-clean package (was ~8 errors); a clean package is a far better regression canary than a 1600-error crate.

packages.name: idna
packages.note: Comparable in size to urllib3, never tracked round to round.

packages.name: charset_normalizer
packages.note: Unblocked in round 53 (reassigned-param boxing): converts and builds (~314 rustc errors after round 55's re-alias dispatch + warn signature + json dumps arm, measurable).

packages.name: requests
packages.note: Round 54 (boxed isinstance-dispatch drops loudly) unblocked conversion; round 55 added the urllib.parse runtime surface (urlparse/urlsplit/urljoin/urlunparse/urlencode/quote/unquote/urldefrag) and the class-vs-function import registry (~69 rustc errors, measurable).
